definitions: An open-source observability framework for instrumenting, generating, collecting, and exporting telemetry data (metrics, logs, and traces).
A set of tools, APIs, and SDKs used to standardize the way applications emit telemetry data.
examples: Many cloud-native applications leverage OpenTelemetry for distributed tracing.
Implementing OpenTelemetry can provide deep insights into system performance.
The community actively contributes to the OpenTelemetry project.
